<!-- review-cost: effort medium, no escalation -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thank you for the fixes. Both findings of the review at `0d695b266` are closed on this head. The recipe fix covers the class, not only the one case.

## What looks good

- Finding 1 is closed. The undo and redo handlers in `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:379-395` use the `if !... { return Err(...) }` form. The `bool::then` call is gone, and clippy is clean.
- Finding 2 is closed. `crates/app/src/commands/operation/recipe.rs:54` calls `CreateOperation::with_named_entry(..., true)`. A saved `entry: helix` is kept.
- The class is closed on every Offset2D create door:
  - A plain create keeps `named_entry = false` and applies the law against the seed (`crates/app/src/commands/operation/create.rs:151`).
  - MCP `add_operation` sets `named_entry` when the request names `entry` (`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:300`).
  - Recipe apply sets `named_entry = true` (`recipe.rs:54`).
  - Paste and duplicate copy the operation params and do not run the create law (`create.rs:235-286`).
  - Pocket recognition makes a Pocket or a Slot only (`crates/app/src/recognize/op.rs:16-20`).
  - A project load restores the stored params.
- An explicit Helix, Ramp or Plunge in one edit stays. The MCP pin covers it, and so does the unit test at `crates/app/src/operation/types/start_side_entry.rs:70-99`.
- Undo restores the previous entry in one step (`crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start/start_side_entry.rs:54-65`).
- No system writes the field. Only the two command constructors call `with_start_side_entry` (`create.rs:151` and `crates/app/src/commands/operation/edit.rs:125`).
- The new pin `cut_recipe_keeps_explicit_helix_on_start_side_offset` (`crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start/start_side_entry.rs:123`) proves the recipe case.
- Every changed file is under 400 lines: `recipe.rs` 130, `mcp/edit.rs` 395, `start_side_entry.rs` 151, `create.rs` 352.
- The body has a `Changelog:` line and ends with `Fixes #3863`. The commit subjects are conventional.
- No new dependency, no `build.rs`, no `.github/`, no scripts change, no golden or snapshot change, and no process file.

## Results, merged with `origin/main` `d4601c6ea` (built locally)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `origin/main` `d4601c6ea` | clean, no conflict |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` | 55 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (5.5 min); includes `app build`, `app suites: lib` (307 passed) and `cut_recipe` (20 passed) |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start` | 12 passed, 9 ignored (the heavy fig8 tests); all five `start_side_entry` tests passed, with the four pins and the new recipe pin |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 307 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean, 0 warnings |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog` | 41 passed, 4 ignored, 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (15.0 min): `motion light: lib` 7 passed, `adaptive_troch_island` 1, `adaptive_troch_neck` 1, `adaptive_troch_parallel` 1, `app light: pocket_pass_start` 1 |

## Targeted tests

- The light lane ran and is green (row above). It is the required targeted step here.
- The example catalog suites ran, because the change can change a toolpath entry (row above).
- This is a P3 PR under no safety-floor heavy rule. It gets no heavy step, and none ran.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The Gate map at `crates/app/tests/offset_pass_start/start_side_entry.rs:7-8` names `app::commands (EditOperationParams)`, `app::operation` and `app::mcp`. The file now also covers `ApplyCutRecipe` and `app::cut_recipe`. A one-line update names them.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3843-start-side-arc.md` still says "The edit door changes instead", and its cost line names one call. The create door now applies the law too (`create.rs:151`). The new bullet names the named-entry case. A wording update makes the file agree with the code.
- The `use` reorder and the `probe_kept` helper in `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:149-166` are outside #3863. They keep the same behavior, and clippy is clean. No action is needed.

I set `merge-ready` and removed `needs-rework`: this review is clean and the PR is MERGEABLE.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
